shortDescription: Ukraine, with its energy system under daily Russian attack, is creating a network of underground fuel storage facilities, Energy Minister Denys Shmyhal said on Wednesday.

children: Ukraine, with its energy system under daily Russian attack, is creating a network of underground fuel storage facilities, Energy Minister Denys Shmyhal said on Wednesday.
The priority is to ensure an uninterrupted supply of diesel fuel, primarily for defence needs and critical infrastructure, he said in a statement.
In recent weeks, Russia has intensified attacks on fuel stations, destroying or damaging around 300 of them, primarily in frontline regions.
Shmyhal said Ukraine and Romania had agreed to expand fuel supply capacity to Kyiv via both rail and river ports.
